title: digitalis dubia f. longipedunculata
intro: Digitalis dubia f. longipedunculata, commonly known as a variant of the Foxglove plant, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of cardiovascular diseases and hypertension due to its ability to improve heart function and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis dubia f. longipedunculata are attributed to its glycosides, particularly digoxin and digitoxin, which have cardiotonic and inotropic properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include cardiac glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
